intro: A quiet week for factual orders, with the UK public broadcasters supplying almost all of it: renewals for proven formats, a BBC Arts history series and a digital spin-off of BBC Scotland's Murder Trial. Channel 4 also confirmed Married at First Sight UK will not return, saying the budget will go into new programmes.

commissions.title: The Hormone Fix
commissions.what: One-off 60-minute factual special in which Davinia Taylor looks at how hormones shape sleep, mood, stress and energy, with experts and contributors. Due on Channel 4 next year.
commissions.commissioner: Clemency Green (Senior Commissioning Editor) and Jo Street (Director of Commissioning, Nations & Regions)

commissions.title: Our Farm Next Door: Amanda, Clive and Kids (series 5 and 6)
commissions.what: Double-series renewal for More4's top-rated show, following the Owen family as they restore a derelict Swaledale farmhouse alongside farm life at Ravenseat.

commissions.title: The Fans Who Fought Back: The Battle for Blackpool
commissions.what: Sky Original feature doc (1x60) on Blackpool FC's rise to the Premier League and the long supporter campaign against the Oyston family. Directed by James Newton; airs 21 November.
commissions.commissioner: Phil Edgar-Jones (Executive Director, Unscripted Originals); Commissioning Editor Jo Hughes

commissions.title: Beethoven: Rise of a Genius
commissions.what: Three-part drama-documentary for the 200th anniversary of Beethoven's death, drawing on his letters, immersive sound design and Deaf contributors. Co-production with ZDF and PBS.
commissions.commissioner: Suzy Klein (Head of BBC Arts and Classical Music TV); Commissioning Editor Mark Bell

commissions.title: Inside Murder Trial: Death of a Dog Walker
commissions.what: Nine-part video podcast for iPlayer and YouTube extending the Murder Trial strand, with a journalist and a defence KC analysing each day of the Aberfeldy murder trial.

moves.name: Alisa Pomeroy
moves.change: Channel 4's Head of Documentaries and Factual Entertainment becomes Head of Unscripted from January 2027, taking in Specialist Factual (announced 28 October).

moves.name: Rhuanedd Richards
moves.change: Confirmed as Director, BBC Nations (Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and BBC Local in England) after serving in the role on an interim basis; joins the BBC Executive Committee.

moves.name: Kate Phillips
moves.change: BBC Chief Content Officer (and former Director of Unscripted) joins the BBC Board as an executive director.

funding.title: Digital Accelerator - funding awards
funding.what: Four North East indies (Adventure Alliance Films, FilmNova, Northern Child, Wander Films) each receive £100,000 to develop digital-first content for YouTube, TikTok and similar platforms.
